project.name: awesome-web-agent-security
project.title: Awesome Web Agent Security
project.description: A curated and dynamically generated paper repository for Web Agent Security, covering prompt injection, tool security, deceptive interfaces, privacy, availability, benchmarks, and defenses.

papers.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
papers.summary: A foundational benchmark for agent security with tool execution, untrusted external data, and indirect prompt injection test cases.

papers.title: Formalizing and Benchmarking Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses
papers.summary: Provides a formal framework for prompt injection attacks and defenses, useful for SoK-style abstraction.

papers.title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
papers.summary: A major benchmark for indirect prompt injection in tool-integrated agents, including direct harm and private-data exfiltration.

papers.title: WebInject: Prompt Injection Attack to Web Agents
papers.summary: A core Web Agent Security paper focused on visual-layer prompt injection against MLLM-based web agents.

papers.title: The Task Shield: Enforcing Task Alignment to Defend Against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
papers.summary: Represents intent and task-alignment defenses that check whether instructions or actions serve the original user task.

papers.title: MELON: Provable Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks in AI Agents
papers.summary: Introduces masked re-execution as a behavioral or causal runtime defense against indirect prompt injection.

papers.title: Cloak, Honey, Trap
papers.summary: Useful for deception, honey tokens, and traps against malicious autonomous LLM agents.

papers.title: The Dangers of Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on LLM-based Autonomous Web Navigation Agents
papers.summary: Demonstrates indirect prompt injection in BrowserGym-style web navigation agents.

papers.title: Prompt Injection Attack to Tool Selection in LLM Agents
papers.summary: Moves the attack surface from web content to tool descriptions, tool retrieval, and tool selection.

papers.title: ObliInjection: Order-Oblivious Prompt Injection Attack to LLM Agents with Multi-source Data
papers.summary: Models multi-source observations where attackers control only part of the context and do not know final ordering.

papers.title: MUZZLE: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Web Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
papers.summary: A focused Web Agent Security paper on adaptive red-teaming from agent trajectories and feedback.

papers.title: AttriGuard: Defeating Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents via Causal Attribution of Tool Invocations
papers.summary: Studies whether tool invocations are causally driven by user intent or untrusted observations.

papers.title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier: Indirect Prompt Injection in the Wild for LLM Systems
papers.summary: Highlights attack delivery and reachability: malicious content must be retrieved before it can compromise an agent.

papers.title: When Efficiency Becomes a Vulnerability: Computational Cost Attacks on WebAgents
papers.summary: Expands Web Agent Security beyond goal hijacking into availability and resource-consumption attacks.

papers.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
papers.summary: Shows that web-agent security includes interface-level manipulation, not only explicit prompt injection.

papers.title: SecureWebArena: A Holistic Security Evaluation Benchmark for LVLM-based Web Agents
papers.summary: A holistic benchmark with realistic web environments, adversarial trajectories, and multiple attack vectors.

papers.title: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
papers.summary: Shifts analysis from a single vulnerable LLM toward modern web-agent architecture vulnerabilities.

papers.title: Network-Level Prompt and Trait Leakage in Local Research Agents
papers.summary: Broadens the corpus beyond prompt injection into network metadata leakage and privacy side channels.

papers.title: JARVIS or Ultron? A Survey on the Safety and Security Threats of Computer-Using Agents
papers.summary: Important neighboring survey scope covering web, desktop, and mobile computer-using agents.
